raw_market.question: 4Q Spread: Kansas State (-2.5)
raw_market.description:
In the fourth quarter of the college football game between Houston and Kansas State, scheduled for October 10 at 3:30 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Kansas State" if Kansas State outscore Houston by 3 or more points in the fourth quarter.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Houston".

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
